1	# Placeholders
2	
3	{% raw %}
4	
5	Placeholders let one action definition work for every card. They are written as `{{name}}` and resolved on the desktop side, just before the process starts.
6	
7	| Placeholder | Resolves to |
8	| --- | --- |
9	| `{{card-file}}` | Path to the selected card's Markdown file. |
10	| `{{this-card}}` | Alias of `{{card-file}}`; the same path to the selected card's Markdown file. |
11	| `{{card-title}}` | Title of the selected card. |
12	| `{{card-prompt}}` | The extra text you typed in the action popup for this run. |
13	| `{{active-cards-folder}}` | Absolute path to the configured working folder under the opened repository. Active cards are root-level Markdown files in this folder shown on the dashboard. |
14	| `{{worktree-folder}}` | Absolute path to the action execution checkout. |
15	| `{{repository-folder}}` | Absolute path to the opened repository. |
16	| `{{project-folder}}` | Absolute path to the configured `project.projectFolder` under the opened repository. Equal to `{{repository-folder}}` when configuration is empty. |
17	| `{{releases-folder}}` | Absolute path to the configured releases folder under the opened repository. |
18	| `{{diagram-file}}` | Output path for a diagram action. Available when the action has diagram output. |
19	| `{{parent-node}}` | Label of the selected item when running a child diagram action. |
20	| `{{diagram-changes}}` | Generated text from reviewed diagram edits when sending changes to an agent. |
21	| `{{version}}` | Free-form answer confirmed for the current action run. Linked actions use the same answer. |
22	| `{{conflict-file}}` | Path of the conflicted file the action was started for in the merge conflict dialog. |
23	| `{{conflict-files}}` | Paths of all files still conflicted in the merge conflict session, one per line. |
24	
25	They work in both `prompt` (agent actions) and `command` (command actions).
26	
27	## Using them
28	
29	In the prompt editor, type `{{` for a typeahead list, or insert one from the toolbar.
30	
31	```json
32	{
33	  "id": "fix-bug",
34	  "label": "Fix bug",
35	  "description": "Fix the bug described on the card",
36	  "type": "agent",
37	  "prompt": "Fix the bug described in {{card-file}}.\n\nExtra instructions: {{card-prompt}}"
38	}
39	```
40	
41	```json
42	{
43	  "id": "open-in-editor",
44	  "label": "Open in VS Code",
45	  "description": "Open the card file in VS Code",
46	  "type": "command",
47	  "command": "code {{card-file}}"
48	}
49	```
50	
51	## Notes
52	
53	- A card placeholder only resolves when the action runs with card context. Use `appliesTo` with `"kind": "card"` so an action that needs `{{card-file}}` or `{{this-card}}` is only offered where it makes sense.
54	- Diagram placeholders need diagram context. `{{diagram-file}}` also needs an output path, `{{parent-node}}` needs a selected item in a child diagram context, and `{{diagram-changes}}` needs reviewed changes from the editor.
55	- Conflict placeholders need merge-conflict context. `{{conflict-file}}` only resolves when the action was started for one file, not from **all remaining files**.
56	- `{{card-prompt}}` is empty when you run without typing anything. Write prompts that read fine either way.
57	- `{{version}}` requires a confirmed or explicitly supplied version. Without one, executable text fails before it runs.
58	- During linked-worktree actions, `{{repository-folder}}`, `{{project-folder}}`, and `{{active-cards-folder}}` remain under the opened repository. Only `{{worktree-folder}}` changes to the linked worktree.
59	- The diff command in project configuration supports the same five folder placeholders plus `{{commit}}`, `{{branch}}`, and `{{file}}`. For diffs, `{{worktree-folder}}` and `{{repository-folder}}` both resolve to the opened repository.
60	- Custom agent profiles support `{{model}}` in `command` and `{{sessionId}}` in `resumeCommand`. Those are profile placeholders, not action placeholders.
61	
62	{% endraw %}
63	
64	See also: [Action definition](action-definition.md), [Diagrams](../guide/diagrams.md), [Cookbook](cookbook.md).
